    Meetings

    The 7 meetings of the Student Council, Tha Prachan, with the minutes in full.

    Published by
    Thammasat University Student Council, Tha Prachan (TUSC)
    Period covered
    13 May 2025 to 19 March 2026, academic year 2568 (2025 to 2026)
    Last updated
    31 October 2026
    Next update
    To be announced

    Main points

    • The council met 7 times in 3 sessions between 13 May 2025 and 19 March 2026, and recorded 38 decisions.
    • Every recorded vote has no votes against.
    • The minutes of the latest meeting (19 March 2026) have no recorded adoption yet.
